description_en: Moves a resource to a specific resource group
description_zh: 修改资源所属的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun ros move-resource-group --resource-type stack --resource-id 4e8611cb-251e-42b7-b9cb-3496362c0000 --new-resource-group-id rg-acfm3peow3k0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: MoveResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

stack: stack

stackgroup: stack group

template: template
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，取值：  

stack：资源栈。  

stackgroup：资源栈组。  

template：模板。

templatescratch：资源场景
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which you want to move the resource. For more information about resource groups, see the "Resource Group" section of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html topic
parameters.help_zh:
新资源组ID。
关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the resource.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
资源所属的地域ID。  
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
